description: Queues up to 100 URLs of one property for submission to search engines, by two routes: IndexNow (Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam, Yep; needs the IndexNow key set for the property) and Google through the Indexing API (optional per property; Google documents that API for job postings and live-stream videos). Parameters: urls (absolute URLs inside the property), action update (default) or delete, engines (indexnow and/or google; default: the routes configured for the property). Returns queued (url + engine), skipped with a reason per URL (invalid_url, outside_property, duplicate_24h, daily_limit_indexnow, daily_limit_google, google_not_allowed_by_plan, google_not_configured, indexnow_not_configured) and creditsLeft ({indexnow, google}: URLs still allowed today on each route; null = no daily limit on that route; each route has its own daily limit). A submission is a request, not a confirmation: get_indexing_requests shows what was sent and list_url_inspections what Google reports. Writes only to Organiq (the request queue) and sends the URLs to the selected engines; it does not change Search Console. Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Errors: indexing_not_configured with the panel step; plan_limit only when none of the requested engines is allowed by the plan (google_not_allowed_by_plan) or the daily credit is zero. A spent daily credit is not an error: the URLs come back in skipped with reason daily_limit_indexnow or daily_limit_google. / Envia até 100 URLs para indexação (IndexNow e, opcional, Google Indexing API); grava só no Organiq e não altera o Search Console.

action.description: update (default): the URL was created or changed; delete: the URL was removed.

engines.description: Routes to use (default: the ones configured for the property).

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: request_indexing
title: Request indexing of URLs
